This is the DDX3X substitution into the module's progenitor-division node: the perturbation reaching the cell cycle is translational rather than centrosomal.

It is retained here as a genuine but provisional arm: it grounds the sex-dependent dosage argument, and it has not been shown to be the route to any specific human brain phenotype.
